verdicts.why: Dropping Eastview Police Department is right: that job is 2023 backstory seen only in the episode 6 flashback. Westview Shopping Mall Security is a workplace that no record or dataset entry tracks as a group, so under the owner's rule it is not added. That leaves the coven as her only group.

His U.S. Army service ended with the Korean War and his decades of imprisonment, long before The Falcon and the Winter Soldier, where he is a Baltimore recluse. The Army is listed as 'formerly', so it is backstory.

Marc joined the Marines, went AWOL, was discharged and became a mercenary, all before Moon Knight. In the series, Steven is fired from the National Art Gallery gift shop in episode 2 ('Summon the Suit').

verdicts.why: The move holds: he trains with Ying Nan and fights with Ta Lo's army (MCU Wiki lists him as an inactive soldier), then returns to San Francisco. The dataset's existing name for this group is 'Ta Lo', not 'Ta Lo Armed Forces'.

She left Kamar-Taj for Chicago to raise Zelma long before Ironheart, and her infobox lists the Masters of the Mystic Arts as 'formerly'. In the series she runs Stanton's Sweets, Reads & More, so the MMA is backstory.
She was freed when the Red Room fell in 2016, years before Brave New World, where she is already President Ross's security advisor. The Red Room is backstory.
His summer job as Alfredo's Bail Bonds' chicken mascot ended with his firing before Project Sentry. In Thunderbolts* it appears only as a memory inside the Void, so it is backstory.

In S3 'Framed', Peter quits the Daily Bugle to work as a troubleshooter at Fisktronics (Marvel Database episode synopsis and bio), and by S3 'The Ultimate Slayer' he is back at the Bugle. Fisktronics is already a group in the dataset (the Fisk records).

The Spider-Men are a one-mission team. At the end of 'Spider Wars' Spider-Carnage is destroyed and 'All the Spider-Men have been returned home' (Wikipedia). Marvel Database lists the team as Defunct with every member former.
The team dissolves once Spider-Carnage is defeated and every Spider-Man is sent home (Wikipedia S5E13 summary). Marvel Database lists the Spider-Men as Defunct and him as a former member.
The Beyonder teleports Man-Spider away during the mission (Wikipedia S5E12), and the team is dissolved at the end. Marvel Database lists the Spider-Men as Defunct with him as a former member.
All the Spider-Men are sent home after Spider-Carnage's defeat, and the actor goes back to his own world (Wikipedia S5E13). Marvel Database lists the team as Defunct.

The only claim that they disband again is a single prose line on the Marvel Database team page. The S5E6 episode page does not tag the team as disbanding, and the Wikipedia summaries of 'Six Forgotten Warriors' never mention it either. That makes this an unsure case, so the record stays as it is.
In S2E13 Martha and Curt leave ESU Labs with Billy for the Florida Everglades to escape Miles Warren's blackmail (Marvel Database). This is the same departure already recorded on Curt's record.

The Independent stage is right: Nelson and Murdock is dissolved in Daredevil S2 ('Nelson and Murdock Dissolved', 'Seven Minutes in Heaven'). Landman and Zack should also go. Matt and Foggy quit it before Daredevil S1 opens, and it is seen only in the S1 flashbacks (episode 10), so it is backstory.
Karen's job at Penny's Place, her family's Vermont diner, is seen only in the S3 'Karen' flashback, before she left for New York and long before Daredevil S1. It is backstory.
In Daredevil S1 episode 12, Ellison suspends Ben and then fires him on the spot. Fisk kills him afterward, so Ben dies no longer at the Bulletin.

In Daredevil S2 episode 8 Elektra tells Stick she will fight the Hand without the Chaste and drives him off. In episode 10 Stick sends Duchamps to kill her, and she then kills Stick's Chaste men. The Chaste is listed as 'formerly' until the Hand resurrects her in The Defenders.

MCU Wiki lists Josie as a member of Daredevil's Army (the record's 'Matt's resistance'). It gathers at her bar at the end of Born Again S1 and uses it as a hideout in S2 episode 2, while she still runs the bar.

His Marine Corps and Savannah police service both ended before his Seagate imprisonment, years before Jessica Jones S1, and are seen only in Luke Cage S1 flashbacks. The included CIA exit also checks out (see the next item).

In Born Again S2 episode 8 ('The Southern Cross'), Mr. Charles has replaced Luke with Bullseye. Luke says his CIA work is done and comes home to Jessica and Danielle, and the infobox lists the CIA as 'formerly'.

In the Jessica Jones S1 finale (JJ113), Malcolm answers Jessica's phone and asks the caller how the agency can help. He keeps working with Alias and is promoted to associate in S2, so the Alias stage starts at S1.
In Luke Cage S2 episode 6, Misty announces her resignation to Ridenhour and turns in her badge. After his murder she rejoins the precinct in episode 8 ('Rejoining').
